description: Amendments of v4's state machines that the owner approved (ODR-V41-08, APR-V41-OWNER-2). v4 is frozen at tag indy-init-requirements-v4.0.0 and its files are never edited: requirements-compiler v41 applies each transition over the frozen machines when it compiles state-machine-contracts.json. Check X12 requires each transition and accepted entry to name a state-machine-amendment request and its operator approval, sources that are baseline requirements, and a fit with its machine (known states and events, deterministic guards, Saved entered only by a confirmation); the offline suite checks that the owner's selected option adds exactly these transitions. No state or event is added. MutationSent is stepped by the App runtime when it hands the outstanding mutation to Execute (IF41-SAVE).

transitions.guard: current: its RequestId is the session's Outstanding request, which awaits MutationAnswer
effects: record that the outstanding createCommitOnBranch was handed to Execute; the state, the base head, Outstanding (RequestId, MutationAnswer) and the unsaved changes are unchanged

accepted.note: SM-LOAD keeps no transport-failure event: a provider refusal, a transport failure or a lost answer during a load is LoadRejected carrying LoadFailure.ProviderFailed (IF41-SAVE), as the owner accepted. No transition is added.
